title: Ordinary etale system evaluation operations exist
statement: For a compactification c of f:X→Y and a natural number l, exact normalized level evaluations exist for every finite l-power-torsion coefficient sequence on X, c.Z, and Y.

proof.text: Evaluate strict module systems componentwise at each vertical level and compose with the constant-module realization. The sectionwise constant-sheaf construction and sheafification preserve the required additive finite-limit and finite-colimit structure; package the three resulting Evaluation families.

mathlib_searches.query: evaluation functor exact additive finite limits finite colimits constant module etale site
mathlib_searches.results: No declaration packages the composed level and constant-module evaluation used here; existing componentwise evaluation APIs supply the construction.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSystemProjectionEvaluationData_nonempty
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f) (l : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      ((∀ B : Coefficients.{u} l, ∀ n : ℕ, Evaluation X B.rings n) ∧
        (∀ B : Coefficients.{u} l, ∀ n : ℕ, Evaluation c.Z B.rings n) ∧
          (∀ B : Coefficients.{u} l, ∀ n : ℕ, Evaluation Y B.rings n))
